subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2010 Winter Olympic Games - London**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2010 Winter Olympic Games** were held in **Vancouver, Canada**, not London.
 
• **Beijing** hosted the **2022 Winter Olympic Games**, becoming the first city to host both the Summer and Winter Olympics.
 
• **Sochi** hosted the **2014 Winter Olympic Games** in Russia, marking the first time the Winter Games were held in Russia.
 
• **PyeongChang** hosted the **2018 Winter Olympic Games** in South Korea, known for being the first Winter Olympics held in the country.
